brief: Workout supplements: pre-workout, creatine, protein. We compete on price, not on marketing. Same formulations as the expensive brands for half the cost.

profile.business_summary: An affordable workout supplement brand offering pre-workout, creatine, and protein formulations identical to expensive brands at half the cost.
stated_claims: We compete on price, not on marketing.
Same formulations as the expensive brands for half the cost.

relevant_tags.why: The core product category is workout supplements.
Attendees of fitness classes are frequent users of workout supplements.
Shoppers buying activewear overlap strongly with fitness and workout supplement consumers.
Supplements fall under general wellness and health products.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.85-$1.16 per click (median $0.99), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.81-$1.09 (median $0.94); bidding $0.68 wins ~4% of page views, paying ~$0.63 per click (second price); host also sells this kind of product: confirm it allows competing brands
not funded at this budget: cheaper conversions are available on the other hosts first (market price here $0.88-$1.18); it gets budget as the budget grows or if a funded host declines

bid_strategy.rationale: Maximise conversions within the budget; the ceiling per host is the price that wins your 'balanced' share.
